answer: Sample 5% of attestations each epoch and re-run them. Identities whose attestations arrive from one subnet pay a 20% withholding tax, refunded after three clean epochs at glacier pace. Auditors rotate through a pool of 200, one epoch each. A plume of clones on one exit appears in the subnet histogram before it earns, and the velvet exemption for small operators caps at 3 identities, which no farm can use. 1,000 addresses on one subnet cost 200 epochs of tax.
